policy.scope: Non-neural authored carriers only; not real-media or production-provider accuracy.
policy.checkpoint: Explicit MIT SA-1B checkpoint only, matched to pinned publisher mirror SHA256. Original noncommercial COCO weights excluded.
policy.storage: Download checkpoint directly into bounded RAM; verify full length/SHA256 before restricted tensor loading. Retain identity/loaded-tensor receipts; replay requires reacquisition. No source checkpoint is stored on disk.
policy.images: Six deterministic256x256 RGB authored carriers; unmarked/full mark/center128x128 partial mark/ordinary rotated center crop; native/JPEG70/down128-up256 bilinear variants.
policy.preprocessing: Publisher ImageNet transform; native F32 generation with fixed alternating32bit message, scaling_w2, original JND config. Unnormalize/clamp/half-up RGB8 quantization; partial copies marked center pixels only.
policy.mask_readout: Native first-channel logits strictly>0; retain every logit and pixel.8-connected components>=500pixels are inspection regions; this is a proposed inspection rule, not a validated false-alarm guarantee.
policy.message_readout: Publisher-supported hard method: each raw bit logit>0, pack all32 binary maps; majority over selected mask pixels. Empty mask is unavailable. Raw continuous bit logits are unused and not retained.
policy.video: Three authored moving8frame clips at2fps. Unmarked/partial states; partial center mark on frames2:6 only (1–3s), raw frames and H264CRF23; preserve8 decoded frame PTS and exact source coordinates.
policy.parity: Four first-scene wrapper/direct detector comparisons; first partial repeat bit-exact. No response-based point change or case removal.
policy.inference: CPUfloat32, twoTorch threads, seed20261108; guard900s/6GiB sampledRSS/1536MiB availableRAM/disk.
